svg.title: Trino Flow Materialization Contract
svg.desc: Flow diagram for exposed-trino showing queryFlow materialization, pagedQueryFlow page boundaries, chunked batch insert, cancellation checks, and Trino connector-dependent execution.
svg.text: Flow APIs close JDBC transactions before emission; paged Flow bounds materialization without exposing a live cursor.
Cancellation is checked before each page and emitted item; an in-flight JDBC page still closes its transaction before collection stops.
